<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0103-28-28" status="reviewed">'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">mchims</rs> na re sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa zhes bya ba las bcu' 2 zhes
            bya ba'i grangs mdo'aM bstan chos gang na'ang ma mthong ngo zhes zer kyang | <rs type="work">rgyud bla ma</rs> nas bcu' 2su mngon te | <quote>thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen || 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni
            || chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par || skye ba mngon par skye ba dang || dga' ltar gnas °°° dang || <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="8b3"/> lhuMs su 'jug dang bltas pa dang || gzhon nu rol ched mdzad pa
            dang | btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa dang || nges 'byung dga' ba spyod pa dang | byang
            chub snying por gshegs pa dang || bdud sde 'joMs dang rdzogs par ni || byang chub chos gyi 'khor lo dang || mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnaMs || srid pa ji srid gnas par ston ||</quote>
            zhes <expan>bcad do</expan> || </seg></TEI>
